39:t_10:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm not sure what that means, but as long as you're safe.」

39:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I can't afford to let anything happen to this $$Ｚクリスタル$$ or the $$Ｚチップ$$s either. I take the utmost care of them.」

39:t_10:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$ told me about you, but you really do love $$Ｚチップ$$s, don't you?」

39:t_10:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you don't mind, could you show me an actual one?」

39:t_10:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's beautiful... It almost feels like my mind could be drawn into it...」

39:t_10:42.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm fine, I'm fine. I just had a little headache.」

39:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's a relief... If anything happened to you, $$かなめ$$, I couldn't face $$宗介$$ either.」

39:t_10:44.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You sure make a big deal out of things, $$ＡＧ$$.」

39:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then please prove that you're feeling well.」

39:t_10:46.en:
$$かなめ$$
「All right, all right. $$アルト$$ and the others told me how this goes.」

39:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then here we go! Let's get fired up for another day of...」

39:t_10:48.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Business, business! And for good measure, big business!」

39:t_10:49.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for that extra-special service. Just what I'd expect from a 《$$ウィスパード$$》.」

39:t_10:50.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What... How did you know that...!?」

39:t_10:51.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Heh heh... I have my ways. Don't underestimate a dimensional merchant's information network.」

39:t_10:52.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Yes... Your presence will have a major effect on what happens from here on...)

40:t_001:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「There is a 78.23% match with $$ＵＣＷ$$'s terrain data.」

40:t_001:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Yes. While $$蒼の地球$$ was formed by the merger of $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$, using $$ＡＤＷ$$'s Earth as its base...」

40:t_001:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「$$翠の地球$$ must indeed be based on $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

40:t_001:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「According to $$ブルー$$, the northern part of the $$中央大陸$$, $$翠の地球$$'s largest landmass, is controlled by Earth's forces.」

40:t_001:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「First, let's descend into the Northern Hemisphere and contact the local forces.」

40:t_001:8.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「I confirm a group of units approaching from $$翠の地球$$...!」

40:t_001:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They've come, just as we expected.」

40:t_002:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「It's a $$サイデリアル$$ interception force!」

40:t_002:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「There are so many...! And some units we've never seen before!」

40:t_002:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Launch all units. We cannot descend unless we break through here!」

40:t_003:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Welcome, everyone from $c. I've heard so much about you.」

40:t_003:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Fate has brought us together here... Allow me to introduce myself.」

40:t_003:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My name is $$サルディアス・アクス$$. As you can see, I'm with $$サイデリアル$$, and I have the honor of commanding this force.」

40:t_003:5.en:
$$ルカ$$
「The enemy commander wants to make contact...?」

40:t_003:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Be careful. He might be trying to make us let our guard down.」

40:t_003:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, no... Given your reputation as seasoned veterans, I wouldn't dream of thinking my petty chatter could make you drop your guard.」

40:t_003:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But I do have my position to consider, so this is part of my duties, you see. Yes, indeed.」

40:t_003:9.en:
$n
「Sorry, but we have no intention of listening to you.」

40:t_003:10.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Wait, $l. First, we'll see what he intends to do.」

40:t_003:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, thank you very much. Young people really are far too hasty. As they say, haste makes waste.」

40:t_003:12.en:
$$アル$$
「Those are quite profound words. He seems to be a commander with considerable life experience.」

40:t_003:14.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You must have some purpose in going out of your way to arrange this little conference. Tell us what it is, promptly.」

40:t_003:15.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I criticized the young man's haste earlier, but I don't exactly have unlimited time myself.」

40:t_003:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「With so few years left in this old body, I don't relish wasting time.」

40:t_003:19.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... My sense of humor just doesn't seem to match you Earthlings'.」

40:t_003:20.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then I'll get straight to the point. Please surrender at once.」

40:t_004:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That bastard...! He had them prepare an attack while he babbled all that nonsense!」

40:t_004:2.en:
$$柿小路$$
「He's quite a cunning old fox.」

40:t_004:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha, I appreciate the compliment, but I'm not quite old enough to merit the 'old' part.」

40:t_004:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, begin attacking! Target the enemy commander's unit!」

40:t_004:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We must also consider what comes next. Once five minutes have elapsed, we will attempt a forced breakthrough.」

40:t_004:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll take that old guy down before then!」

40:t_004:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'll show that con man the power of youth!」

40:t_004:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... Please go easy on me.」

40:t_005:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain, the enemy's targets are...」

40:t_005:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and the $$クォーター$$, I imagine.」

40:t_005:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「If we lose our ships, we'll have to abandon the descent operation... It's a sound tactic.」

40:t_005:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「He understands what this battle hinges on... That commander, $$サルディアス$$, seems even more devious than I expected.」

40:t_005:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, protect the ships...! The enemy is going to break through!」

40:t_005:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It seems you've read our intentions. Well played.」

40:t_005:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... knowing what we're doing and being able to stop it are two different things. Yes, indeed.」

40:t_006:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, dear... Now I can't very well make fun of $$ギルター$$.」

40:t_006:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We have neutralized the enemy commander! Now's our chance!」

40:t_006:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We'll force our way through!」

40:t_007:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$! Any further fighting will affect our strategy going forward!」

40:t_007:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Right...! We'll force our way through!」

notes: Sardias uses obsequious politeness while stalling for his attack. Cunning old fox preserves Kakikouji's age component so Sardias's reply still works. Tessa and Mardukas identify the two ships as the enemy targets.
